ctx.x: We've touched sort of lightly on Art Tatem. I know you were with him on two different occasions. The first time I think was for two years in Chicago. But we haven't really talked at any great length about Tatem. What was he like?

Well, he was very fine person, a great -- as we know he's a great musician, and a great card player. You know, he's had -- I would say he -- he wasn't totally blind, he -- let's say, I would say he was 90 percent blind though. But he could -- he had a photographic memory, and we would play -- when we were at the Three Deuces in Chicago we -- he loved to play cards, and we would play the boss, Sam Beards, and whoever, and Art and I would always team up. And Art would remember every card that hit the board, you…

We would drink so much we couldn't work sometimes -- I couldn't, he could. But he -- you know, because Art loved to drink, as you know. And drink or smell, that's what we would call him. So they would smell and buy and we would drink.
